exec: pm.test("Expected dispatch summary", () => { const s=pm.response.json().summary; pm.expect(s.totalOrders).to.eql(30); pm.expect(s.assignedOrders).to.eql(22); pm.expect(s.unassignedOrders).to.eql(8); pm.expect(s.totalLoad).to.eql(490); pm.expect(s.totalDistance).to.eql("73.42 km"); });
